svg.aria-label: France: the airports hit by the last civil-service strike
svg.text: France: the airports hit by the last civil-service strike
29 September 2026 - the DGAC asked for cuts at Paris-CDG and Marseille; disruption expected at five regional airports
Source: Natural Earth; Reuters via Euronext (29 Sept 2026), Airkarma (26 Oct 2026)
